question: Within the same fixed Japanese regional frame, does the already validated occurrence-conditioned environmental-support representation recover later novel occurrence clusters better than direct nearest-known distance or deterministic spatial balance?

environmental_support.candidate_surface_rule: same frozen 800-point regional surface semantics used by the validated Japan core
environmental_support.prototype_thinning_rule: reuse validated core semantics; no temporal-outcome-driven tuning

nearest_known.selection_count: exactly match environmental-support candidate count on the same regional candidate universe

spatial_balance.selection_count: exactly match environmental-support candidate count on the same regional candidate universe

decision_rule.primary: compare pair-level environmental-support minus nearest-known and environmental-support minus spatial-balance at 10 km; retain failures as zero/no replacement
decision_rule.development_success_requires: positive mean difference against both strong baselines with direction not confined to one taxon group; this may nominate a method but cannot confirm it
decision_rule.if_success: freeze nominated method unchanged and sample a new disjoint public confirmation cohort before any external local-discovery claim
decision_rule.if_fail: do not tune radii, precision, support fraction or feature weights on these 96 opened pairs

forbidden: change six validated terrain features because of temporal outcomes
claim new independent confirmation from these 96 pairs
